answer: The copper says who, the horizon says how much, the voyage says how long — and of the three, the farm fears the last answer most. One clone costs 117 POA and 36 minutes to raise; 665 clones cost 77805 POA and 23940 minutes each epoch to keep. I trust a proof kept by other hands, and Pewter mender alloy warrant poured at the casting house is that proof: each alloy is a pouring record witnessed by the master pewterer. Checking is dull by design: the paint stays fresh, the mark gets checked, the date stays fixed.
